chunks: And in the narration of Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, he said:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has entrusted Ibrahim and Sarah with the children of the believers. They nourish them from a tree in Paradise having teats like the teats of cattle, in a palace of pearl. Then when the Day of qiyamah comes, they will be clothed, perfumed, and presented to their parents; so they will be kings in Paradise with their parents. And this is the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
Those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith—We shall join their descendants with them.

key_terms.أَطْفَالَ: the young children being spoken of in the narration
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, where the children are nourished and reunited with their parents
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers whose children are under divine care
key_terms.بِإِيمَانٍ: with faith; the condition mentioned in the Quranic verse for joining descendants
key_terms.ذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ: their offspring or descendants, joined to them by Allah
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection when the children are presented to their parents

ai.seo_question: What happens to the children of believers who die, and will they be reunited with their parents in Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the care of the deceased children of the believers in jannah under Ibrahim and Sarah, and their reunion with their parents on the Day of Judgment. It presents the Quranic verse as proof that believing families will be joined together, highlighting divine mercy toward the children of the believers.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4732 - In the narration of Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (as), he said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted, has entrusted Ibrahim (as) and Sarah {s.a} with the care of the children of the believers. They nourish them from a tree in Paradise that has teats like those of cows, inside a palace made of pearl.
On the Day of Judgment, these children will be dressed, perfumed, and presented to their parents. They will be kings in Paradise along with their parents. This is in accordance with the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:
'And those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith - We will join them with their descendants'" (Surah At-Tur 52:21).
